## Summary

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Docker or manual smoke test, if relevant

## Safety

- [ ] No auth files, QR payloads, API keys, cookies, full phone numbers, full JIDs, message text, or raw production logs are included.
- [ ] The change stays within single-account self-hosted scope.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for frontend UI changes, if relevant.
